commands.name: configure
commands.description: View or update CLI settings (api_base, token)

commands.name: measures coverage
commands.description: Count scenarios that passed measures validation in a window (fleet measure-coverage over time)

commands.name: measures failed
commands.description: Count scenarios that failed measures validation in a window

commands.name: search query
commands.description: Match an analytical question to a measure and return the computed answer (the search-hub measure provider)

commands.name: validate coverage
commands.description: Roll up measure coverage across every discovered scenario (the fleet view)

commands.name: validate scenario
commands.description: Grade a scenario's measure coverage (expected/covered/waived) and optionally probe its declared measures end-to-end
